# Raw GDPR source (do not edit)

`gdpr-celex-32016R0679-en.html` is the untouched EUR-Lex HTML for Regulation (EU) 2016/679, EN.
Parsers read it; nothing writes to it. Provenance and checksum are in `metadata.json`.

Re-fetch rules (EUR-Lex robots.txt): Crawl-delay 10s; `/legal-content/*/TXT/DOC/`, `/TXT/SIG/`,
`/print-pdf`, `/document-format.html` are disallowed. Plain `curl` gets an AWS WAF challenge, so use a real browser.
